name: smwgraphics-sonic-cd-quartz-quadrant-present-indoors
title: Sonic CD - Quartz Quadrant (Present, Indoors)
description:
The BG from the underground sections of Quartz Quadrant's Present in Sonic the Hedgehog CD. Sample level included that has the glowing effect for the crystals like in the original game.
Uses 2 full ExGFX files and part of FG2, and uses only 1 palette row.

Big update: I decided to rip the BG from scratch. Since the BG was too big, I decided to place each parts into 3 sample levels total. All 3 are included in the archive.
Also, the BG uses 1 GFX file total and the crystals are animated, except this time, only 1 GFX slot is used.

Have fun using it and no credit required.
